image_summary.preliminary_near_duplicate_note: Computed via a naive 8x8 average-hash exact-match grouping over the audit's per-image scan. This is a coarse first-pass indicator only. Authoritative near-duplicate detection with configurable pHash/dHash similarity thresholds and leakage-safe train/val/test grouping belongs to src/duplicate_detection.py (project Phase 3) and MUST be run before any split is trusted for training.

metadata_summary.metadata_pairing_explanation: No structured metadata files (csv/json/xlsx/xls) were found under the data root. The dataset description mentions expert annotations (soil health, humidity, nutrient deficiency, pathological reports) but these are not present in the downloaded archive contents. Multimodal experiments that require per-image or per-sample metadata are DISABLED until such a file is located and its linkage to images is verified.
